title: With security groups for pods (ENABLE_POD_ENI=true), aws-node needs get/list/watch/patch on cninodes.vpcresources.k8s.aws

detection.reason: ClusterRoles and env VALUES are not collected

quote: Add watch permission for CNINode resource
remediation: From v1.15 ipamd records its features on the node's CNINode object (patch) and, in v1.15.5–v1.19.3, caches CNINode for every cluster (list/watch); from v1.19.4 the cache is gated by ENABLE_POD_ENI. Clusters that run security groups for pods must upgrade with the release manifest / chart / EKS add-on so the aws-node ClusterRole carries get/list/watch/patch on cninodes.vpcresources.k8s.aws — an image-only bump keeps the old ClusterRole and the CNINode calls are forbidden.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterrole aws-node -o json | jq -r '[.rules[] | select((.apiGroups // []) | index("vpcresources.k8s.aws")) | .verbs[]] | unique | join(",")'  # needs get,list,patch,watch when ENABLE_POD_ENI=true; empty = the ClusterRole predates v1.15
coversNotes: Feature - Add support for VPC Resource Controller's CNINode (reintroduce #2442)
